description: CI authority for repository config artifacts that intentionally do NOT belong to the runtime population. Separate from cli/lib/nftban/data/config-registry.json, which is the RUNTIME config-surface inventory. Two authorities on purpose: one file must never define both a population and its own completeness.
note: Not installed to /etc/nftban and not runtime configuration. Production-consumer census 2026-09-11 proved NO production code reads config-registry.json ENTRIES: the three production consumers validate JSON syntax only (cmd_health_components.sh:444-448, health/check_registries.sh:118) and NFTBAN_REGISTRY_FILE (nftban_config_schema.sh:59) is declared once and never used.

conf.d/rbl/main.conf.local.disposition_evidence: *.conf.local is deleted from the buildroot by design at packaging/build_nftban.sh:593; ships to no host.

modules/actions.conf.disposition_evidence: Suricata policy input; reader internal/suricata/policy.go:100 LoadPolicy is DEFINED_UNREACHED (zero callers). Surface retired by owner ruling D2, service_control.sh:594-600.

modules/detection.conf.disposition_evidence: Reader internal/suricata/policy.go:89 (constructed path, keys consumed generically via TrimPrefix 'detect_'); LoadPolicy has zero callers. Retired surface D2.

modules/inline_exceptions.conf.disposition_evidence: NOT an intentional source-only artifact. inline.go:30 CLAIMS the file is parsed and no parser exists; the consumer API IS reachable (IsEffectivelyEnabled, 3 external callers) and runs on DefaultInlineConfig(). Moving it out of the runtime registry is CLASSIFICATION, not resolution.

service-security.conf.disposition_evidence: Repo-side CI contract consumed by tools/validate-service-security.sh:31 as CONTRACT_FILE; read-only, never staged. Absent from all 788 package entries.

suricata/routing.conf.disposition_evidence: Reader internal/suricata/router.go:510 LoadRoutingConfig is DEFINED_UNREACHED (zero callers). Retired surface D2.

suricata/rules/disable.conf.disposition_evidence: EXTERNAL_TOOL_ONLY (suricata-update); zero payload lines; no NFTBan invocation of --disable-conf anywhere. Retired surface D2.

suricata/rules/enable.conf.disposition_evidence: EXTERNAL_TOOL_ONLY (suricata-update); zero payload lines; no NFTBan invocation of --enable-conf anywhere. Retired surface D2.

update.conf.disposition_evidence: Source input install/config/update.conf has no install line; the runtime subject is conf.d/update.conf (proven shipped). Moving this key out is CLASSIFICATION - it does NOT declare the duplicate identity healthy.
